assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of unexplained syncope and transient neurological deficits suggestive of transient cerebral ischemic attacks.
A long-term continuous ECG monitoring study (CPT 93247) is ordered.
The service is medically necessary to identify intermittent arrhythmias that standard evaluation cannot capture.
The denial under CO-29 requests an exception to the filing deadline.
This appeal demonstrates that the service addresses the documented clinical indications of recurrent syncope and transient cerebral ischemic attacks.
